title: Sleep timing and next-day focus
claim: Earlier sleep timing may improve next-day focus through increased sleep duration, controlling for caffeine intake.
assumptions: sleep timing is measured before next-day focus
caffeine intake and weekday are observed
no claim stronger than testable candidate is allowed
falsification_tests: negative control outcome unrelated to focus
data_requirements: at least several weeks of repeated observations
test_plan: Run temporal placebo, negative control, and conservative counterfactual matching before any stronger conclusion.
